content: OpenShell v0.1.4 podman driver: rootless containers; requires Podman 5.x, cgroups v2, and an active user socket (systemctl --user start podman.socket); compute_driver auto-detect order Kubernetes, Podman, Docker (VM never auto-detected); gateway TOML must start with [openshell] version=2; bind mounts need enable_bind_mounts and disabling resource admission; podman volume mounts lack subpath; workspace lives in writable layer unless a volume. Source: docs.nvidia.com/openshell/latest/how-it-works/sandboxes/runtimes.
